  "title": "Unable to cast object of type 'System.Byte[]' to type 'System.String",
  "body": "Hi guys,

I am having an issue on an entity with a string property which is saved in database as a byte array. I can generate the models using dotnet-ef, however I could not retrieve the entities via dbcontext as it always throws the below exception:

    System.InvalidOperationException: An exception occured while reading a database value for property 'Member.PostCode'. The expected type was 'System.String' but the actual value was of type 'System.Byte[]'. ---> System.InvalidCastException: Unable to cast object of type 'System.Byte[]' to type 'System.String'.
       at Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Internal.EntityMaterializerSource.TryReadValue[TValue](ValueBuffer valueBuffer, Int32 index, IPropertyBase property)

       --- End of stack trace from previous location where exception was thrown ---
       at System.Runtime.ExceptionServices.ExceptionDispatchInfo.Throw()
       at System.Runtime.CompilerServices.TaskAwaiter.HandleNonSuccessAndDebuggerNotification(Task task)
       at Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Query.Internal.AsyncLinqOperatorProvider.ExceptionInterceptor`1.EnumeratorExceptionInterceptor.<MoveNext>d__5.MoveNext()

### Further technical details
EF Core version: (1.1.2)
Database Provider: (Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer)
Operating system: Windows 10
IDE: (e.g. Visual Studio Code)

    "id": 314605731,
    "html_url": "https://github.com/dotnet/efcore/issues/9142#issuecomment-314605731",
    "body": "External issue https://github.com/dotnet/corefx/issues/18276

@jasondaicoder - This is not EF Core bug. The underlying SqlClient in .NET core does not support `column encryption setting`. Since the setting is not enabled, while fetching records from server, EF receives encrypted value of byte[] type which cannot be assigned to string property hence it threw exception.
